highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Nottingham Trent University (NTU), established in 1843, is a distinguished public research university located in Nottingham, England. It’s one of the UK's largest institutions, where you’ll join a vibrant community of over 40,000 students and staff across multiple campuses. You’ll be part of the university’s 9 academic schools, including Nottingham Business School and Nottingham Law School. Plus, you’ll be studying at an award-winning university. NTU was named The Times and The Sunday Times Modern University of the Year 2023 for its outstanding student experience, strong graduate prospects and world-class research.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: Studying at NTU means being part of a dynamic student community. You’ll be among more than 40,000 students from around 120 countries. NTU boasts several student-led societies, from academic and professional groups to cultural and recreational ones. Not just that, the university also offers support services, such as Student Support Advisers, Specialist wellbeing support, and many more to help you.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
According to the Uni Compare Top 100 Rankings for university accommodation, Nottingham Trent is the second best in the UK as a place to live while you study. You can choose from several accommodation options on campus, including NTU’s Halls of Residence and University Shared Houses.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At NTU’s library, you have access to extensive academic resources through the Libraries and Learning Resources service. The collection includes over 500,000 books, journals, and digital materials. You can also access resources online through the Library OneSearch system.

Sports
You get a wide range of sports and fitness facilities at NTU. At the City Sports Centre within the Students' Union building, you’ll find a multi-purpose sports hall, indoor pitches and courts, a two-storey gym, a sports therapy suite, a dance studio, and a 30-foot climbing wall. Plus, you can find more such amenities at the Clifton Sports Hub, on the Clifton Campus.

Laboratory
You can find several state-of-the-art laboratories across various disciplines. For example, the Interdisciplinary Science and Technology Centre (ISTeC) on the Clifton Campus houses advanced laboratories for Sport and Exercise Science research and many more such lab facilities.

Cafeteria
NTU offers a variety of cafes and eateries across its campuses. You’ll find a selection of grab-and-go breakfasts, sandwiches, pastries, snacks, hot food, and drinks at Cafe Newton. You can also grab lunch and quick eats from Cafe Darwin in the Erasmus Darwin building on the Clifton Campus. In addition, the Nottingham Trent Students' Union (NTSU) operates various cafés and shops across NTU’s campuses.
